patterns: APPSC asks direct one-liners: biodegradable vs non-biodegradable item (tin, wool, peels), zero-waste city (Indore), 3R odd-one-out ('Regain'), urban disposal methods ('all the above').
Rule-year-goal items recur: MSW Rules 2000 = segregation; PWM Amendment 2021 = SUP phase-out by 2022; EPR origin = E-waste Rules 2011 (UPSC).
Strong AP/current-affairs tilt: CLAP launch date (2 Oct 2021) incl. assertion-reason, APPCB RDF in cement kilns, Water Plus cities, Swachh Survekshan themes.
Disposal-method matching (organic-composting, e-waste-recycling, hazardous-incineration, glass-landfill) and WtE terms (pyrolysis, plasma gasification) are favourite match items.
App MCQs are far denser than PYQs: many multi-statement items on 2026 rules, EPR targets, SC orders and statistics that the exam has not yet tested at that depth.
